deadline.value: Applicants who need a UK visa must apply by 2 August 2027 for a September or October 2027 start. The page gives no earlier funding deadline.
deadline.quote: For research courses that start in September and October 2027, the application deadline for students who require a visa to study in the UK is 2 August 2027.

gre_subject.value: The course page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Contact the academic staff you want to work with before applying; the School welcomes these enquiries.
supervisor.quote: The academic staff in the School welcome enquiries from potential research students, so you are advised to contact them directly.

funding.value: The course page does not state a funding rule.

entry_route.value: The minimum is a 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent) in a Life Sciences related subject.
entry_route.quote: 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent) in a Life Sciences related subject.

notes: Single research-project PhD. The course page lists research themes including Neuroscience and Environment & Ecology.
